title: Bounded reachability ball
statement: Let $K,L\in\mathbb{N}$, let $R$ be a relation on natural numbers, and let $\mathrm{Init}$ and $\mathrm{Acc}$ be predicates on natural numbers. The ball at level $L$ is the finite set of natural numbers $t<K$ for which there is some $u<K$ satisfying $\mathrm{Init}(u)$ and connected to $t$ by a walk of length at most $L$ using $R$.
